verdict.line: You lose if you let Shadow Dash taunt you into a trade on cooldown; you win by baiting Vorpal Blade and punishing Feint's long cooldown pre-6.

brief.thesis: This is a 40% win rate over 50 games despite even lane grading, because Shen's W (Feint) absorbs your short burst and Q (Vorpal Blade) sustain-trades you while you lack the stacks to break through. Your Q (Ntofo Strikes) needs two hits to fire its pull, and Shen's kit is built to stall exactly that window.

theirWindow.when: Feint is up (9-5s cooldown by rank)
theirWindow.what: Shen will shield through your all-in and poke back with Q (Vorpal Blade) for free sustain. Don't commit your full combo into a fresh Feint — you'll waste cooldowns into a block.

yourWindow.when: Feint on cooldown, you hold Ntofo stacks
yourWindow.what: Walk up and land Q (Ntofo Strikes) twice to trigger the shockwave pull, then follow with W (Path Maker) for the stun. This is your only real damage window before level 6 — take it every time Feint is down.

start.why: 91.9% pick rate here — the extra early HP and sustain let you survive Shen's Q (Vorpal Blade) life-tap trades without losing the lane to attrition.

boots.why: 58.6% pick rate; Shen's Shadow Dash taunt chains into auto-attacks, so the flat damage reduction blunts every follow-up hit after you're locked.

core.why: First item in both top build paths — the on-hit slow lets you land your Q (Ntofo Strikes) stacks before Shen can disengage with Feint.
Appears second in every listed core path; stacking resistances directly counters Shen's mixed physical/true damage split and scales your late trades.
75% win rate over the small sample as the third item — attack speed slow punishes Shen's Ki Strike auto-reset pattern in extended fights.

runes.keystoneWhy: Run on both listed pages (17.7% and 14.5% pick) — the proc rewards you for walking up to trade every time Shen's Feint is down, which is your entire win condition pre-6.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run on 44.4% of games (14.5% pick) with the highest win rate of the listed combos — Ignite turns your level 3-5 all-in window into a kill threat since Shen has no hard sustain reset to answer it early.

playing.title: Hold Q stacks for the pull
playing.detail: Your Q (Ntofo Strikes) only fires its shockwave pull at 2 stacks. Don't waste the first hit poking from max range — land both in the same engage or Shen walks out before the pull triggers.

playing.title: Track Feint before every trade
playing.detail: Feint's cooldown drops from 9s to 5s by rank 5. Before committing W (Path Maker), confirm Feint is down or you're stunning into a block with nothing to show for the cooldown.

playing.title: Respect Shadow Dash range at 6+
playing.detail: Shadow Dash has 575 range and taunts on contact. Don't stand in a straight line from Shen past level 6 — sidestep so he has to commit the dash without a guaranteed taunt.

playing.title: Trade into his Q cooldown, not yours
playing.detail: Vorpal Blade heals Shen's allies who attack you after the tap — irrelevant 1v1, but it's also his main damage tool at 4-4.5s cooldown mid-game. Punish the window right after he uses it.

playing.title: Use W (Path Maker) charge-up defensively too
playing.detail: The charge phase reduces damage taken before the dash. If Shen all-ins with Shadow Dash into a trade, pre-charging W can absorb the taunt-auto combo while you set up your own stun.

playing.title: All Out changes your kit, not his
playing.detail: R (All Out) removes your W's knockback/stun in exchange for damage — don't expect a second stun from W after popping R. Land Path Maker's stun before you ult if you need the lockdown.

playing.title: Don't force all-ins through a fresh Feint
playing.detail: If Feint just came back up, delay your engage by a few seconds rather than dumping your full rotation into a guaranteed shield absorb.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and the 40% win rate over 50 games are measured from live OP.GG data on the current patch; the trade-pattern reasoning and timing calls are my own analysis.
